contrastHint: More draws quiet text and lines stronger, in any palette. Only this device follows this setting.

channelLayout.deleteCategoryHint: Its channels are kept and move out of it. Whatever access the category set for them goes with it, so check who can see them afterwards. This can't be undone.

notifications.desktopHint: For messages your notification settings ask for, while Aspen is open but you are looking elsewhere.

notifications.soundsHint: Through the speaker chosen for notification sounds under Audio.

search.textHint: Every word must appear. Use "quotes" for a phrase, or for either, and -word to leave one out.
search.noneBackTo: Nothing matches back to {date}. Older messages haven't been searched yet.
search.deeper: Nothing yet. Searching further back, past {date}…

folders.labelOpen: {name} folder, open, {count, plural, one {# community} other {# communities}}

activity.noneDms: Nothing here yet. Your direct messages show up here.
activity.noneThreads: Nothing here yet. Replies in threads you follow show up here.
activity.noneShown: Everything is filtered out. Choose what to show under Show.

plugins.alteredByHint: A plugin of this server changed what was written before it was sent.
plugins.dmNoticeHint: This server's administrators run plugins that read direct messages here, as they read messages in communities.
plugins.heading: Plugins
plugins.intro: Plugins add to what this community can do. This server's administrators install them; you choose which run here.
plugins.everywhere: Runs in every community on this server.
plugins.needsPlugin: This channel is shown by a plugin this server does not run here. Its administrators can turn it on.

plugins.pressFailed: {plugin} could not do that. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell this community's moderators.

plugins.noSettings: It has nothing to set here.
plugins.secretSet: A value is set. Type a new one to replace it.
plugins.adminIntro: Plugins are installed, upgraded, and removed on the server, with aspen-chat-server plugins. Here you turn them on and off, choose where they run, and change their settings.
plugins.adminNone: No plugins are installed. Install one with aspen-chat-server plugins install.
plugins.modeOptIn: In the communities that turn it on
plugins.storage: Keeps {used} in all, at most {quota} for each community, DM, or person

permissions.messages.refuse: Refuse messages before they are sent
permissions.attachments.read: Read the files attached to messages
permissions.dms: Read and act in direct messages
permissions.network: Send what it sees to the hosts it lists
permissions.act: Act through an account of its own
permissions.views: Show pages of its own in the apps
permissions.timers: Wake itself at times it sets
permissions.capabilities: Give out private links that need no sign-in

federation.title: Federation
federation.hint: Other Aspen deployments, and whether this one's users and bots may use them or theirs may use this one: the gates, and the lists they read.
federation.notFederating: This deployment takes no part in federation. Its operators set a domain under [federation] in aspen.toml to publish its key and open its gates.
federation.keyPending: Made when the server next starts
federation.sharedListHint: Both gates then read one list, so they must be the same kind of list.
federation.immigrationInviteRequired: A first arrival needs a registration invite
federation.gatesHint: Closing a gate, or narrowing it, signs out at once the visitors from deployments it no longer admits.
federation.addHint: It is contacted as soon as it is added, and the key it presents is pinned.
federation.addedNotReached: Added {domain}, but it could not be contacted: {detail}

outcome.handedOver: {domain} replaced its key, vouched for by the one you pinned. The new key is pinned.
outcome.keyChanged: {domain} presented a different key. It is refused until you accept it.

federation.listsHint: Only the lists your gates read are shown.
federation.noListsInForce: No gate reads a list, so lists change nothing here.

listNames.usersImmigrationBlock: Its users may not come here
listNames.usersSharedBlock: Users may neither come nor go
listNames.botsImmigrationBlock: Its bots may not come here
listNames.botsSharedBlock: Bots may neither come nor go

federation.keyHint: Accept it only once its administrators have told you they replaced their key, and the fingerprint they give matches. A key that changes unannounced may mean someone else answers at its domain.
federation.forgetHint: Its pinned key and the lists it is on are removed. If it is contacted again, whatever key it presents is pinned.

viewDashboard.name: View the dashboard
viewDashboard.hint: See the server's totals, growth, health, users, communities, and the moderation log.

manageRegistrationInvites.name: Manage registration invites
manageRegistrationInvites.hint: Make and revoke the invites new accounts are created with.

manageVoiceServers.name: Manage voice servers
manageVoiceServers.hint: Add, change, and remove the servers calls run on.

manageDeploymentRoles.name: Manage deployment roles
manageDeploymentRoles.hint: Create, change, reorder, give, and take deployment roles below their own highest.

manageFederation.name: Manage federation
manageFederation.hint: Open and close the gates to other deployments, add and forget them, check and accept their keys, and edit the lists that decide who may come and go.

moderateCommunities.name: Moderate any community
moderateCommunities.hint: See everything on the server, DMs included, and the record of files sent in calls; delete messages, attachments, reactions, members, channels, and communities. Includes Remove content. Every use is logged.

reviewReports.name: Review reports
reviewReports.hint: Read what people report, with the messages around a reported one (a DM's is logged), dismiss it, or resolve it with a warning from the server's moderators.

removeContent.name: Remove content
removeContent.hint: Delete a reported message, clear a reported nickname, reset a reported profile, and delete a banned person's recent messages. Every use is logged.

manageReportCategories.name: Manage report categories
manageReportCategories.hint: Add, rename, reorder, and hide the categories people choose from when they report something.

banUsers.name: Ban users
banUsers.hint: Ban accounts from the whole server, ending their sign-ins, and lift bans. Every use is logged.

messageAnyUser.name: Message any user
messageAnyUser.hint: Start a DM with anyone, whatever communities they share and whoever blocked whom.

manageDeploymentSettings.name: Manage deployment settings
manageDeploymentSettings.hint: Change the server's name and icon, and its policies: registration invites, second factors, email, bots, community limits, and files in calls; delete bots whose owners have deleted their accounts.

managePlugins.name: Manage plugins
managePlugins.hint: Turn installed plugins on and off for the whole server, change their settings, and choose where they run and in what order. Installing them is done on the server itself.

sendNewsletters.name: Send newsletters
sendNewsletters.hint: Write posts for the server's email newsletter, send tests to yourself, and send them to every subscriber.

viewJobs.name: View jobs
viewJobs.hint: See what the server's background work is doing: what runs, what waits, and what failed, never what each job was given.

manageCommunity.name: Manage community
manageCommunity.hint: Rename the community and change its icon.

manageChannels.name: Manage channels
manageChannels.hint: Create, edit, arrange, and delete channels, and set who can use them.

manageCategories.name: Manage categories
manageCategories.hint: Create, rename, and delete categories, and set who can use their channels.

createInvites.name: Create invites
createInvites.hint: Make invite links for new members.

manageInvites.name: Manage invites
manageInvites.hint: See, change, and revoke everyone's invites, not just their own.

manageRoles.name: Manage roles
manageRoles.hint: Create, edit, reorder, and delete roles below their highest one.

assignRoles.name: Assign roles
assignRoles.hint: Give members roles below their highest one, and take them away.

removeMembers.name: Remove members
removeMembers.hint: Remove members ranked below them. They can come back with an invite.

banMembers.name: Ban members
banMembers.hint: Ban members below your highest role, with a reason and for a time, and lift bans.

changeNickname.name: Change nickname
changeNickname.hint: Choose a name of their own in this community. Anyone can clear their nickname.

manageNicknames.name: Manage nicknames
manageNicknames.hint: Clear the nicknames of members ranked below them.

manageMessages.name: Manage messages
manageMessages.hint: Delete anyone's messages and take down poll answers.

pinMessages.name: Pin messages
pinMessages.hint: Pin and unpin messages in channels.

manageCalls.name: Manage calls
manageCalls.hint: Mute people in calls for everyone, and remove them from calls.

addBots.name: Add bots
addBots.hint: Add bots to the community from their links. Giving a bot permissions also takes Manage roles and Assign roles.

manageCustomEmoji.name: Manage custom emoji
manageCustomEmoji.hint: Add, rename, and remove the community's own emoji.

viewChannel.name: View channels
viewChannel.hint: See a channel and read its history.

attachFiles.name: Attach files
attachFiles.hint: Add files and pictures to messages.

startThreads.name: Start threads
startThreads.hint: Open a thread from a message.

speak.name: Speak
speak.hint: Talk in calls. Without it, people join to listen.

shareScreen.name: Share screen
shareScreen.hint: Share a screen, window, or game in calls.

transferFiles.name: Transfer files
transferFiles.hint: Offer files to the others in a call, sent straight from device to device.

useCamera.name: Use camera
useCamera.hint: Turn on a camera in calls.

mentionMembers.name: Mention members
mentionMembers.hint: Tag people in messages, which they're told of.

mentionRoles.name: Mention roles
mentionRoles.hint: Tag a role, telling everyone who holds it.

mentionEveryone.name: Mention everyone
mentionEveryone.hint: Tag @everyone, telling everyone who can see the channel.

managePlugins.name: Manage plugins
managePlugins.hint: Turn this server's plugins on and off here, change their settings, and read them.

communitySettings.heading: {community} settings
communitySettings.noOwner: This community has no owner. A server administrator can name one.
communitySettings.transferConfirm: Hand {community} to {name}? They become its owner, and you keep your roles. Only they can hand it back.
communitySettings.moderatorNote: You are here as a moderator of this server; what you change is logged.
communitySettings.deleteHint: Deletes every channel and message in it, for everyone. This can't be undone.
communitySettings.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the community's name to confirm
communitySettings.leaveConfirm: Leave {community}? You'll need an invite to come back.

roles.everyoneHint: Every member has this role. What it allows, everyone can do.
roles.deleteConfirm: Delete the {role} role? Members who have it lose what it allows.
roles.aboveYou: This role is at or above your highest role, so you can't change it.
roles.notHeld: You can only give permissions you have yourself.
roles.colorHint: Names of members with this role are drawn in its colour in this community, unless a higher role of theirs has one. Aspen sets how light it is, so every colour stays readable.
roles.hoistHint: Online members with this role are listed under it in the member list, and are among the first the list shows.

members.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from {community}? They can come back with an invite.
members.sampleNote: The members seen most recently are listed.
members.banHint: They are removed from {community} and cannot come back with an invite until the ban ends or is lifted.
members.banReasonHint: Shown to them when they try to come back.
members.bannedAndDeleted: Banned {name} and deleted {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}.
members.voiceMutedNone: No one is muted in this community's calls.

access.categoryNote: Settings here apply to every channel in the category, unless a channel sets its own.

presets.everyoneHint: Every member can see it and take part.
presets.privateHint: Only members with the roles you choose can see it.
presets.readOnlyHint: Everyone can read it, but only the roles you choose can post.
presets.customHint: Set up in the advanced settings. Choosing another option replaces it.
presets.sameAsCategoryHint: Whoever can use the {category} category can use it.

access.createNote: You can change this later, and set each permission, under Who can use this.
access.shutOut: You won't be able to see this channel. Choose one of your roles to keep it.
access.advancedHint: For each role, allow or deny each permission here, or leave it to the role's own settings.
access.checkHint: Pick a member to see what they can do here, and why.

reasons.noRole: None of their roles allows it.

reports.reportMessageHint: Your report goes to this server's moderators, who see the message and the conversation around it. The author isn't told who reported it.
reports.reportProfileHint: Your report goes to this server's moderators, with the profile as it is now. {name} isn't told who reported it.
reports.reportNicknameHint: Your report goes to this server's moderators, with the nickname as it is now and the community it's used in. Its owner isn't told who reported it.
reports.title: Reports
reports.hint: What people reported to this server's moderators. Act on a report, or dismiss it to set it aside.
reports.earlierReports: {count, plural, one {# earlier report is} other {# earlier reports are}} not shown.
reports.noneResolved: No report has been resolved yet.
reports.nicknameGone: They have no nickname there now.
reports.contextLabel: The conversation around the reported message
reports.contextDmNote: This is a DM. Reading it is written to the moderation log.
reports.notYours: Another moderator must review this: it's about you, or about someone whose role isn't below yours.
reports.resolveHint: Choose one or more actions. The report is resolved for good once they're done.
reports.warnHint: Sent to them from the server's moderators, without your name, with what it's about. They can't reply to it.
reports.banHint: They're signed out everywhere and can't sign in until the ban ends or is lifted.
reports.resetHint: Clears what you choose. A username becomes a placeholder they're asked to change.
reports.resetForeign: Their profile belongs to their home server, so it can't be reset here.
reports.clearNicknameHint: They go by their display name in the community again, and can choose another nickname.
reports.categoriesHint: The reasons people choose from when they report something. Built-in ones are shown in each person's language; yours in the words you give them. Other is always offered, last.

selfLinks.longPressForOptions: Press and hold for the original link

newRelease.ready: A new version of Aspen is ready.

contextMenu.unreadableFile: This server's file storage doesn't let the app read files, so this one can't be saved or copied. Its administrators need to let it, as Aspen's operator guide says.
